action: No action needed; for awareness. SAP says it has found no evidence of unauthorized access to customer business data so far.
date_note: The dpa report gives only its own publication day, 26 November; no earlier day is stated.
exec: SAP says it found suspicious activities; it says it has no evidence so far of unauthorized access to customer business data.
geo_basis: headquarters: Walldorf, as stated by the source
plain: SAP says it found suspicious activities and took measures. Der Spiegel called it a hacker attack, which SAP did not confirm. SAP says it has found no sign yet of unauthorized access to customer business data.
summary: SAP told dpa it identified suspicious activities and took measures to protect customers, and that its investigation found no evidence of unauthorized access to customer business data. Der Spiegel reported a hacker attack. Cyber Security News says Der Spiegel, citing sources inside SAP, reported that stolen employee authentication tokens were used to alter and copy source code on GitHub; SAP did not answer detailed questions.
title: SAP says it identified suspicious activities; Spiegel reports a hacker attack, SAP does not confirm

validation.note: dpa (onvista and NWZonline, one report), Cyber Security News and Business Today each report SAP's statement that it found no evidence of unauthorised access to customer business data; Der Spiegel's original and SAP's own statement were not read.

review.note: compared title, SAP no-evidence statement, Spiegel report and token/GitHub claim attributed to Spiegel via Cyber Security News against onvista dpa; SAP did not confirm
